corporation_name.rationale: Corporation name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule K canonical elements list.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule K canonical elements list.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule K canonical elements list.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule K canonical elements list.

ordinary_business_income_loss.rationale: OrdinaryBusinessIncomeLossAmt maps directly to ordinary business income (loss) passed through to Schedule K line 1.

k_ordinary_business_income_loss.rationale: Schedule K line 1 ordinary business income (loss) maps to OrdinaryBusinessIncomeLossAmt.

k_net_rental_real_estate_income.rationale: Schedule K line 2 net rental real estate income (loss) maps to NetIncomeLossAmt; however this is the closest available candidate for net rental real estate income.

k_other_gross_rental_income.rationale: Schedule K line 3a other gross rental income (loss) maps to OtherGrossRentalIncomeLossAmt.

k_expenses_from_other_rental.rationale: Schedule K line 3b expenses from other rental activities maps to ExpensesFromOtherRentalActyAmt.

k_other_net_rental_income.rationale: Schedule K line 3c other net rental income (loss) maps to NetIncmLossFromOthRntlActyAmt.

k_interest_income.rationale: Schedule K line 4 interest income maps to InterestIncomeAmt.

k_dividends_ordinary.rationale: Schedule K line 5a ordinary dividends maps to OrdinaryDividendsAmt.

k_dividends_qualified.rationale: Schedule K line 5b qualified dividends maps to QualifiedDividendsAmt.

k_royalties.rationale: Schedule K line 6 royalties maps to RoyaltiesReceivedAmt.

k_net_short_term_capital_gain.rationale: Schedule K line 7 net short-term capital gain (loss) maps to NetSTCapitalGainOrLossAmt.

k_net_long_term_capital_gain.rationale: Schedule K line 8a net long-term capital gain (loss) maps to NetLTCapitalGainOrLossAmt.

k_collectibles_gain_loss.rationale: Schedule K line 8b collectibles (28%) gain (loss) maps to CollectiblesGainLossAmt.

k_unrecaptured_1250_gain.rationale: Schedule K line 8c unrecaptured section 1250 gain maps to UnrecapturedSection1250GainAmt.

k_net_section_1231_gain.rationale: Schedule K line 9 net section 1231 gain (loss) maps to NetSection1231GainLossAmt.

k_other_income_loss.rationale: Schedule K line 10 other income (loss) maps to OtherIncomeLossAmt.

k_section_179_deduction.rationale: Schedule K line 11 section 179 deduction maps to Section179ExpenseDeductionAmt.

k_cash_charitable_contributions.rationale: Schedule K line 12a cash charitable contributions maps to CashCharitableContriAmt.

k_noncash_charitable_contributions.rationale: Schedule K line 12b noncash charitable contributions maps to NoncashCharitableContriAmt (element, not attribute).

k_investment_interest_expense.rationale: Schedule K line 12c investment interest expense maps to InterestExpenseOnInvstDbAmt.

k_section_59e2_expenditures.rationale: Schedule K line 12d section 59(e)(2) expenditures maps to Section59e2ExpenditureAmt.

k_other_deductions.rationale: Schedule K line 12e other deductions maps to OtherDeductionsAmt.

k_low_income_housing_credit_42j5.rationale: Schedule K line 13a low-income housing credit (section 42(j)(5)) maps to LowIncmHsngCrSect42j5PrtshpAmt.

k_low_income_housing_credit_other.rationale: Schedule K line 13b low-income housing credit (other) maps to LowIncomeHousingCrOthPrtshpAmt.

k_qualified_rehabilitation_credit.rationale: Schedule K line 13c qualified rehabilitation expenditures (rental real estate) maps to QlfyRehbltExpendRntlREActyAmt.

k_other_rental_real_estate_credits.rationale: Schedule K line 13d other rental real estate credits maps to OtherRentalRealEstateAmt.

k_other_rental_credits.rationale: Schedule K line 13e other rental credits maps to OtherRentalCreditsAmt.

k_biofuel_producer_credit.rationale: Schedule K line 13f biofuel producer credit (Form 6478) maps to AlcoholFuelCreditAmt, which is the closest available candidate for this credit type.

k_other_credits.rationale: Schedule K line 13g other credits maps to OtherCreditsAmt.

k_schedule_k2_international_checkbox.rationale: Schedule K line 14a international tax relevance checkbox maps to IntntlTaxRelevanceRptgInd.

k_schedule_k2_exception_checkbox.rationale: Schedule K line 14b domestic filing exception checkbox maps to DomesticFilingExceptionInd.

k_post_1986_depreciation_adjustment.rationale: Schedule K line 15a post-1986 depreciation adjustment maps to Post1986DepreciationAdjAmt.

k_adjusted_gain_loss.rationale: Schedule K line 15b adjusted gain or loss maps to AdjustedGainOrLossAmt.

k_depletion_other_than_oil_gas.rationale: Schedule K line 15c depletion (other than oil and gas) maps to DepletionOtherThanOilAndGasAmt.

k_oil_gas_deductions.rationale: Schedule K line 15e oil, gas, and geothermal properties deductions maps to OilGasAndGeothermalDedsAmt.

k_other_amt_items.rationale: Schedule K line 15f other AMT items maps to OtherAMTItemsAmt.

k_tax_exempt_interest_income.rationale: Schedule K line 16a tax-exempt interest income maps to TaxExemptInterestIncomeAmt.

k_other_tax_exempt_income.rationale: Schedule K line 16b other tax-exempt income maps to OtherTaxExemptIncomeAmt.

k_nondeductible_expenses.rationale: Schedule K line 16c nondeductible expenses maps to NondeductibleExpensesAmt.

k_distributions.rationale: Schedule K line 16d distributions maps to DistributionsOtherThanDivAmt.

k_repayment_loans_from_shareholders.rationale: Schedule K line 16e repayment of loans from shareholders maps to ShareholderLoanRepaymentAmt.

k_investment_expenses.rationale: Schedule K line 17b investment expenses maps to InvestmentExpenseAmt.

k_dividend_distributions_from_accumulate.rationale: Schedule K line 17c dividend distributions paid from accumulated earnings and profits maps to DivDistriPaidAccumEarnPrftAmt.

k_other_items.rationale: Schedule K line 17d other items and amounts is an attach-statement field with no corresponding scalar leaf element in the canonical list.
